Subject: GreenBridge security questionnaire initiation & clarifying questions

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your vendor review moving:

Recap of asks from your team:
- Confirm SOC 2 status and the ability to share a redacted report or summary.
- Clarify HIPAA/BAA requirements (do you expect Redwood to sign a BAA or will a controls attestation suffice?).
- Inventory of what GreenBridge wants to include in the SIG/CAIQ/custom questionnaire (scope: API only vs full platform).
- Evidence items: encryption at rest/in transit, log retention, access control, background checks, incident response playbook.

Our proposed next steps:
1) I attached a short SIG initiation form (Redwood_SIG_initiation_form.pdf) to prefill the obvious fields — please review and send back or tell us the preferred format.
2) We can provide a SOC 2 summary (attached) and redacted report within 48 hours once we validate the request scope.
3) Marissa (security) will handle technical evidence requests; Vivek (SE) can run a short technical walkthrough if needed.
4) Proposed timeline: prefill + clarifying questions: 3 business days; evidence bundle delivery: 7–10 business days depending on scope. If you need an accelerated path, we can prioritize specific controls (e.g., encryption, BAA).

Open questions for you (if you can answer quickly it will help scope the work):
- Do you need a full SIG (control-by-control) or a lighter CAIQ?
- Will PHI be processed/stored by Redwood in your planned integration?
- Who should we send a completed questionnaire to (security@greenbridge.health or a named contact)?

Attached: Redwood_SIG_initiation_form.pdf (prefill), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (summary). Also attached a draft SOW to keep procurement in the loop.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your preferred format and any additional scope notes.

Best,
Jonas

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying items from our side before we kick off the SIG formally:

1) SOC 2 status: is Redwood currently SOC 2 Type II certified? If not, can you share the most recent audit period and whether a Type II report is available for clients?
2) BAA/HIPAA: we will be processing PHI in the planned integration. Will Redwood sign a BAA, or do you require Private deployment/purchase of a Dedicated instance to enable HIPAA coverage?
3) Data residency: we operate primarily in the US East region — can you confirm available region options and where logs/audit data will reside?
4) Questionnaire format: we typically prefer a SIG Lite (control-by-control) with attachments for evidence. Is that okay for Redwood?

I attached our standard vendor security profile (GreenBridge_vendor_profile.pdf). If you can answer Q1–Q3 and confirm the SIG format, we’ll open the formal intake ticket and share the security contact for evidence upload.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Director, IT Security — GreenBridge Health
elena.rossi@greenbridge.health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenBridge security questionnaire initiation & clarifying questions

Elena —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Answers below and some notes on scope/timeline:

Q1 — SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit with coverage through March 2026; we can provide a redacted Type II report or an executive summary immediately. Full report access requires an NDA; summary is attached (Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf).

Q2 — BAA/HIPAA: Redwood can sign a BAA for customers processing PHI. For some deployments customers prefer Redwood Private (VPC/dedicated) for additional contractual controls, but a BAA is available for hosted offerings as well. If you plan to process PHI we’ll route you to our legal team to execute the BAA — please confirm whether you need permitted subcontractor language.

Q3 — Data residency: we have US East (AWS us-east-1) and US West regions for hosted customers. Logs and audit artifacts for your tenant can be retained in the region you select; we will note your US East preference and can include that in the intake.

SIG format: SIG Lite / CAIQ-style is fine. We can prefill the standard SIG fields and attach evidence. If you prefer a custom questionnaire, send it over and we’ll evaluate scope and timing.

Timeline notes: once scope is confirmed we can deliver a prefilled SIG + annotated evidence mapping in ~3 business days for the standard CAIQ/SIG Lite. Full control-by-control evidence (attachments for 30–60 controls) typically takes 7–10 business days depending on required artifacts and any external approvals.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm you want SIG Lite/CAIQ and that GreenBridge will process PHI (so we start BAA discussions).
- Share the security contact for uploads (or we can open a secure ShareFile/Box link).
- If agreeable, schedule a 30-minute kickoff this week with your security team + our security lead (Marissa) and SE (Vivek).

Open for an accelerated path if you can tell us which controls you need first (e.g., encryption, BAA/contract, logging).

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: GreenBridge security questionnaire initiation & clarifying questions

Elena / Jonas — quick technical clarifications from the security team side so we scope evidence correctly: 

- Can you confirm whether GreenBridge will transmit PHI via API calls only, or will you request any long-term storage in Redwood-managed buckets? If storage, we need to know retention windows and whether you require field-level encryption.
- Authentication flow: SSO (SAML/OIDC) or service-account keys? If SSO, which IdP and provisioning model?
- IP allowlisting: will you require a fixed egress IP range for API calls? That will influence Dedicated vs hosted recommendations.
- Logging/forensics: for compliance we typically map the SIG controls to evidence artifacts (e.g., CloudTrail logs, audit log retention policy, KMS key rotation). Please let us know desired retention (90/365 days).

If it helps, we can share a short template that maps GreenBridge questions to specific evidence artifacts we will provide (control name -> artifact name). That speeds review on your side.

Proposed meeting times for a 30m walkthrough (PT): Tue 2026-06-22 09:00, Tue 2026-06-22 11:00, or Wed 2026-06-23 10:00. Which works for your security team?

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Program Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
